passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Muscari matritense Ruíz Rejón, Pascual, C.Ruíz Rejón, Valdés & J.L.Oliv..
The native range of this species is SE. France, Central & S. Spain, W. Central Portugal. It is a bulbous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
